name: Ford - Buffalo Stamping Plant, Hamburg NY

fieldNotes.truckGate: Continuous chain-link perimeter fence rings the property (confirmed in Street View along the Route 5 service road). Main controlled entrance off the NW service road into the front parking/staging lot.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small structure sits at the building base beside the entrance gate; from highway-distance Street View it could be a guard booth or a utility/electrical structure - cannot confirm staffing, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set to true on the basis that a gate exists but no booth is clearly confirmed; low confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multi-track rail yard runs into the property along the entire east/SE side - clearly rail-served (typical for a stamping plant: inbound steel coil, outbound panels).
fieldNotes.dropArea: South and SE yards are full of steel-coil / material storage racks, not parked trailers; only a handful of trailers visible. Not a trailer drop yard.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Dock canopies visible along the east building face near the rail yard; count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site is inside the Buffalo metro fabric (Blasdell/Lackawanna), bordered by Route 5 and dense industrial/residential development -> Urban.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Large open paved frontage between Route 5 and the building leaves ample room for additional lanes.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Lane count not resolvable from highway-distance Street View.

citations.claim: Active NYSDEC environmental permit action for the operating Ford Motor Buffalo Stamping Plant, Town of Hamburg (Mar 2025)
Ford pledged $80M investment in Hamburg stamping plant under UAW deal

verification.rationale: Ford-operated stamping plant; Mar-2025 NYSDEC notice + 2023 UAW reinvestment confirm current operation.
